scope: Public Python CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on the same MeasurementSets. Five-scan independent and common ranges, shared grid axes, calendar day and midnight clocks, raw and binned Channel labels, and 500 by 360 grid, font and legend controls.
baseline_result: Five-scan selfscale-only plots retained local limits. Time figures displayed raw MJD seconds, raw visibility/Time was refused, and the averaged Time/DATA case used calibrated rather than observed weights. Binned Channel retained the raw label. The exteriorRight legend could extend outside the 500-pixel export.
review_controls: Visible labels fit the canvas and neighboring panels, the exteriorRight legend aligns with the plot top, and the first averaged point after midnight sets the next UTC day.
